Consider the motivation for using Transformers instead of RNN-based sequence models. Which of the following option is correct? Statement I : Transformers allow parallel computation across tokens in a sequence during training, whereas RNNs process tokens sequentially across time steps. Statement II : Transformer reduces training time significantly for long sequences compared to RNN-based models.
options: Both Statement I and Statement II are true, and Statement I is the correct explanation of Statement II
Both Statement I and Statement II are true, but Statement I is not the correct explanation of Statement II
Statement I is true, but Statement II is false
Statement I is false, but Statement II is true
questions.correct_answer: Both Statement I and Statement II are true, and Statement I is the correct explanation of Statement II
